# Maverick for Claude Code

The [Maverick](https://github.com/thermiteau/maverick) plugin for Claude Code:
skills, agents and hooks for autonomous, best-practice software development.

**This repository is generated.** Every commit is published by CI from
[thermiteau/maverick](https://github.com/thermiteau/maverick) when a release is
tagged, so the default branch always holds the latest release. Don't edit files
or open pull requests here. File issues and changes in
[thermiteau/maverick](https://github.com/thermiteau/maverick/issues).

## Install

In a Claude Code session:

```
/plugin marketplace add thermiteau/maverick
/plugin install maverick@thermite
```

At session start the plugin installs the `maverick` CLI release that matches
its version (PyPI: `maverick-harness`).
